capabilities: Export a folder or the whole vault to a single DOCX file
Export to one self-contained, print-styled HTML file
Turn wikilinks into bookmark hyperlinks and in-page anchors, including heading links
Embed images in the output file
Preflight scan listing skipped non-Markdown files, missing images and dead links
extras: PDF is produced by printing the HTML export, not by a bundled PDF engine. WebP and AVIF images are embedded in HTML but shown as labeled placeholders in DOCX. Callouts, transclusions, Dataview queries, canvas files and footnotes are not rendered specially.
intentEvidence: No Pandoc. No LaTeX. No command line, no external tools, nothing else to install.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a folder or a whole vault into a single shareable document, and the usual export routes require Pandoc or LaTeX to be installed.

relations.evidence: No Pandoc. No LaTeX. No command line, no external tools, nothing else to install.

summary: Exports a folder or the whole vault into one DOCX or one self-contained print-ready HTML file, with embedded images and working internal links.
